Panax notoginsensoside A (PNA), the major active ingredient of Panax notogin-seng (PN), has the potential to inhibit tumor metastasis by suppressing the expression of matrix metalloproteinases (MMPs), which play a crucial role in the degradation of the extracellular matrix (ECM), and by inhibiting the activation of NF-κB, which plays an important role in tumor metastasis.
